name: symbol_copy
description: Copy a punctuation-only payload from a labeled field; matched control copies its alphabetic tag.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
items=[];control=[]
for i in range(100):
    sym=''.join(random.choice('()[]{}:;+-') for _ in range(random.randint(2,5)))
    tag=random.choice(['red','blue','green','gold','white','black'])
    p='Record: symbols="'+sym+'"; tag="'+tag+'".\n'
    items.append({'prompt':p+'Copy only the symbols, without quotation marks:','answer':' '+sym})
    control.append({'prompt':p+'Copy only the tag, without quotation marks:','answer':' '+tag})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
